text: Briarford, Oct. 17 (Meridian Brief) -- Ellery & Vane bought the rights to The Glass Cartographer, according to people familiar with the matter. The deal was finalized late Wednesday after a brief auction involving three other publishers, the people said. Financial terms were not disclosed, but one person said the acquisition was in the low-seven-figure range, with publication targeted for spring 2027. The novel, by debut author Sera Wint, follows a mapmaker who discovers a city hidden inside a shattered mirror archive. Ellery & Vane plans a simultaneous hardcover, ebook and audio release, with foreign-rights discussions already under way, the people said.
